description.en: An umbrella for regional conflicts among gods, rather than one synchronized battle. The final seat was claimed approximately 2000 BP; the beginning is described only as several millennia ago. The pack does not identify a precise primary passage for this overview.
description.ru: Общее название региональных конфликтов богов, а не одной синхронной битвы. Последний престол был занят примерно 2000 BP; начало описано лишь как несколько тысячелетий назад. Точный фрагмент первоисточника для обзора в пакете не указан.

notes.en: Imported from the supplied research pack, not independently checked against game transcripts. Russian labels are editorial translations unless supplied by the pack or already established in this archive; exact official localization and game version require review.
